content.short: Omega is a cross-margin yield farming protocol on Mantle enabling leveraged strategies across multiple DeFi protocols from a unified margin account.
content.description: Omega is a sophisticated yield optimization protocol for the Mantle ecosystem enabling cross-margin positions across multiple DeFi protocols simultaneously. Users deposit assets and access leveraged yield farming strategies that span lending markets, DEX liquidity pools, and other yield sources  all managed under a unified margin account with automated risk management. Omega's architecture maximizes capital utilization while reducing the complexity of managing positions across multiple protocols.
